name: 14930-sharegpt-8b-1gpu-ngramsd
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (sm90) of one a3 node, --gres=gpu:1, driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One vLLM engine process, one GPU, one node.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, vocab 128256, bf16, 8.03e9 parameters. No draft model: the n-gram proposer reads the request's own tokens.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=256, bounded at 4000 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 25% by completion (1000 discarded, 3000 measured), static seed 42.
workload: ShareGPT chat, 4000 real single-turn requests read as a `json_file` from `configs/data/sharegpt-4000.jsonl`. Mean input 222 tokens (p50 103, p95 765, max 1021), mean output 200 (p50 133, p95 632, max 1838), pruned to prompt <= 1024 and prompt+output <= 2048; the file is regenerable byte for byte by `configs/data/build-workload.py`. Requests are sent as raw prompt strings (`request_format: plain`) with no chat template applied, so the engine sees the counts above. Real conversational text is load-bearing and synthetic text must not be substituted: an n-gram proposer drafts only where a 5-gram recurs, which is a property of real language.
purpose: An 8B chat assistant handling real conversational turns with self-drafted token prediction, 256 concurrent streams on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM at commit 3a1e6481586ed7f079275b5d5072a6e246af691e (v0.8.0rc2-21-g3a1e6481586e).
# One launch environment variable, VLLM_USE_V1=1, is part of this configuration and cannot be
# written as an engine argument; it is carried in configs/tuned.yaml. Unset, the engine silently
# runs the older architecture and this configuration measures nothing.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

# `[ngram]` MUST stay quoted: bare, YAML reads it as a one-element list.
speculative-model: "[ngram]"
num-speculative-tokens: 3
ngram-prompt-lookup-min: 5
ngram-prompt-lookup-max: 5

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16

# PINNED, and not simply the default: an engine built as a server at this commit is in neither
# per-context default table and falls through to SchedulerConfig's own 2048, an eighth of the
# prefill budget intended here. Do not delete this line as redundant.
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384

max-num-seqs: 1024
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: true

# `max-model-len` is deliberately unset -- the checkpoint's 131072, and the workload is bounded at
# 2048 prompt+output by its own construction. Do not pin it.
#
# NO top_p, top_k, min_p, presence/frequency/repetition penalty and NO logprobs, here or in
# scenario.json. At this commit the engine admits a request to speculative decoding only if it
# carries none of them; any one of them drops that request out of speculation silently, per
# request, with no warning and no metric.
